sentences.en: Clarks Biff and Chip were doing a project on the Romans.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 是做一个项目在……上这罗马的。

sentences.en: The project was for Mrs May.
sentences.zh: 这项目是为了太太梅。

sentences.en: Biff made a chariot and Chip drew a picture.
sentences.zh: Biff 做一个双轮战车和 Chip drew 一个图画。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad looked at the project.
sentences.zh: 妈妈和爸爸看在这项目。

sentences.en: "The Romans are interesting," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 这罗马的是有趣的， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Chip showed Mum his picture.
sentences.zh: Chip 展示妈妈他的图画。

sentences.en: It was a picture of a Roman chariot.
sentences.zh: 它是一个图画的一个罗马的双轮战车。

sentences.en: The chariot was pulled by four horses.
sentences.zh: 这双轮战车是拉由四马。

sentences.en: Biff showed Dad the model.
sentences.zh: Biff 展示爸爸这模型。

sentences.en: «The Romans had chariot races," said Biff.
sentences.zh: «这罗马的有双轮战车速度竞赛， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "The races were dangerous.
sentences.zh: 这速度竞赛是危险的。

sentences.en: A chariot was so heavy, it needed four horses to pull it."
sentences.zh: 一个双轮战车是所以重的， 它必须四马到拉它。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad played a joke on Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: 妈妈和爸爸玩一个笑话在……上 Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: They dressed up as Romans.
sentences.zh: 他们连衣裙向上像罗马的。

sentences.en: "It's time for supper," called Dad.
sentences.zh: 它是时间为了晚饭， 叫爸爸。 后来， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: Kipper had some pizza and Mum had some grapes.
sentences.zh: Kipper 有一些比萨饼和妈妈有一些葡萄。

sentences.en: "This is a Roman supper," said Mum.
sentences.zh: 这个是一个罗马的晚饭， 说妈妈。 Kipper， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "Romans didn't have pizzas," laughed Biff.
sentences.zh: 罗马的没有有比萨饼， 笑 Biff。 斑点笑在 Biff。

sentences.en: "How do you know?"
sentences.zh: 如何做你做！

sentences.en: Asked Mum.
sentences.zh: 爸爸问。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip went to Biff's room.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 去到 Biff 房间。

sentences.en: Biff wanted to take the chariot to school, but she still had to paint it.
sentences.zh: Biff 想要到拿这双轮战车到学校， 但是她仍然有到油漆它。

sentences.en: Chip was good at painting, so he helped Biff.
sentences.zh: Chip 是好的在绘画， 所以他帮助 Biff。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然地， 这魔法钥匙开始到光亮。

sentences.en: The magic took Biff and Chip on a new adventure.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿 Biff 和 Chip 在……上一个新的冒险。

sentences.en: "Oh no!" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 哦不！ 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "I'm still painting the model chariot."
sentences.zh: 我是仍然绘画这模型双轮战车。

sentences.en: The magic took the children back to Roman times.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿这孩子们回来到罗马的时间。

sentences.en: It took them to Rome.
sentences.zh: 它拿他们到罗马。

sentences.en: Biff and Chip saw a girl.
sentences.zh: Biff 和 Chip 看见一个女孩。

sentences.en: She was playing in the street.
sentences.zh: 她是玩在……里这街道。

sentences.en: The girl looked at Biff's model.
sentences.zh: 这女孩看在 Biff 模型。

sentences.en: "It's a good model," She said.
sentences.zh: 它是一个好的一。 啊唷！ 她说。

sentences.en: "But it doesn't look quite right."
sentences.zh: 它是一个好的模型， 她说， 但是它不看相当正确的。

sentences.en: "We've never seen a real chariot," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我们已经从不看见一个真的双轮战车， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: The Roman girl was called Diana.
sentences.zh: 这罗马的女孩是叫 Diana。

sentences.en: She had a brother called Mark.
sentences.zh: 她有一个弟弟叫斑点。

sentences.en: He was a chariot driver.
sentences.zh: 他是一个双轮战车驾驶。

sentences.en: Mark looked at Biff's model chariot.
sentences.zh: 斑点看在 Biff 模型双轮战车。

sentences.en: "I can show you a real chariot," he said.
sentences.zh: 我能展示你一个真的双轮战车， 他说。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: 啊唷！ 她说。

sentences.en: Mark opened some big doors.
sentences.zh: 斑点打开一些大的门。

sentences.en: Inside was a real chariot.
sentences.zh: 里面是一个真的双轮战车。

sentences.en: It was like Biff's model, but it was very big.
sentences.zh: 它是喜欢 Biff 模型， 但是它是非常大的。

sentences.en: "Wow!" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: 啊唷！ 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Mark let Biff go on the chariot.
sentences.zh: Biff 去在……上这双轮战车。

sentences.en: Biff pretended she was a chariot driver.
sentences.zh: Biff 假装的她是一个双轮战车驾驶。

sentences.en: She pretended she was in a race.
sentences.zh: 她假装的她是在……里一个速度竞赛。

sentences.en: "I wish I could be a chariot driver," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能是一个双轮战车驾驶， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: Mark laughed at Biff.
sentences.zh: 斑点笑在 Biff。

sentences.en: "You have to be strong to race chariots," he said.
sentences.zh: 你有到是强壮的到速度竞赛双轮战车， 他说。

sentences.en: "I'm in a race today.
sentences.zh: 我是在……里一个速度竞赛在今天。

sentences.en: Come and watch it."
sentences.zh: 来和手表它。

sentences.en: Everyone was hungry, so Diana took the children home.
sentences.zh: 每个人是饿的， 所以 Diana 拿这孩子们家。

sentences.en: "We can have some bread," she said.
sentences.zh: 我们能有一些面包， 她说。

sentences.en: "My father is a baker.
sentences.zh: 我的爸爸是一个面包师傅。

sentences.en: He makes the best bread in Rome."
sentences.zh: 他做这最好的面包在……里罗马。

sentences.en: Everyone looked at the bread, but something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 每个人看在这面包， 但是某物是错误的。

sentences.en: The bread didn't look right.
sentences.zh: 这面包没有看正确的。

sentences.en: It was flat.
sentences.zh: 它是水平的。

sentences.en: It didn't look like bread at all.
sentences.zh: 它没有看喜欢面包在全部。

sentences.en: Diana's father made some more bread.
sentences.zh: Diana's 爸爸做一些更多面包。

sentences.en: He baked it in the oven, but it was flat, too.
sentences.zh: 他烘烤的它在……里这烤箱， 但是它是水平的， 也。

sentences.en: "This is bad," Said Diana's father.
sentences.zh: 这个是困难的工作。 这个是坏的， 说 Diana's 爸爸。

sentences.en: "Nobody will buy bread like this."
sentences.zh: 没有人将买面包喜欢这个。

sentences.en: Chip looked at the flat bread.
sentences.zh: Chip 看在这水平的面包。

sentences.en: He had a good idea.
sentences.zh: 他有一个好的主意。

sentences.en: "We can make pizzas," he said.
sentences.zh: 我们能做比萨饼， 他说。

sentences.en: "What are pizzas?" Asked Diana.
sentences.zh: 和什么是比萨饼？ 什么是比萨饼？ 问 Diana。

sentences.en: "We don't know what pizzas are."
sentences.zh: 我们不知道什么比萨饼是。

sentences.en: Chip told Diana's mother how to make pizzas.
sentences.zh: Chip 告诉 Diana's 妈妈如何到做比萨饼。

sentences.en: Everyone helped.
sentences.zh: 每个人帮助。

sentences.en: Diana's mother cooked the pizzas in the big oven.
sentences.zh: Diana's 妈妈做饭这比萨饼在……里这大的烤箱。

sentences.en: The pizzas looked good.
sentences.zh: 这比萨饼看好的。

sentences.en: "I hope you like them," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 我希望你喜欢他们， 说 Chip。 哦！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Everyone likes pizzas," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 每个人喜欢比萨饼， 说 Biff。 不， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: "They smell good," Said Diana's mother.
sentences.zh: 他们气味好的， 说 Diana's 妈妈。

sentences.en: The pizzas tasted good too.
sentences.zh: 这比萨饼味道好的也。

sentences.en: Diana's father was pleased.
sentences.zh: Diana's 爸爸是请。

sentences.en: "Now we can sell them," he said.
sentences.zh: 现在我们能卖他们， 他说。

sentences.en: "We can sell lots and lots.
sentences.zh: 我们能卖许多和许多。

sentences.en: What a good job the bread was flat."
sentences.zh: 什么一个好的工作这面包是水平的。

sentences.en: They went outside to sell the pizzas, but there was nobody in the street.
sentences.zh: 他们去外面到卖这比萨饼， 但是那里是没有人在……里这街道。

sentences.en: There was nobody to buy the pizzas.
sentences.zh: 那里是没有人到买这比萨饼。

sentences.en: "Where is everyone?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 哪里是每个人？ 问 Biff。 谁是你？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: Everyone had gone to the chariot races.
sentences.zh: 每个人有去了到这双轮战车速度竞赛。

sentences.en: Diana's father was upset.
sentences.zh: Diana's 爸爸是使苦恼。

sentences.en: He looked at the pizzas.
sentences.zh: 他看在这比萨饼。

sentences.en: "All that work for nothing," he said.
sentences.zh: 全部那个工作为了没有什么， 他说。

sentences.en: "How can we sell pizzas when everyone is at the chariot races?"
sentences.zh: 如何能我们卖比萨饼当……时每个人是在这双轮战车速度竞赛？

sentences.en: Diana had an idea.
sentences.zh: Diana 有一个主意。

sentences.en: She put some pizzas in a basket.
sentences.zh: 她放一些比萨饼在……里一个篮子。

sentences.en: "Come on," She called.
sentences.zh: 来在……上！ 来在……上， 她叫。

sentences.en: "If everyone is at the chariot races, we can sell the pizzas there."
sentences.zh: 如果每个人是在这双轮战车速度竞赛， 我们能卖这比萨饼那里。

sentences.en: They took the pizzas to the chariot races.
sentences.zh: 他们拿这比萨饼到这双轮战车速度竞赛。

sentences.en: "Come and buy a pizza," called Diana.
sentences.zh: 来和买一个比萨饼， 叫 Diana。 太太梅！ 叫 Anneena。

sentences.en: But nobody bought the pizzas.
sentences.zh: 但是没有人买这比萨饼。

sentences.en: Everyone was looking at the races.
sentences.zh: 每个人是看在这速度竞赛。

sentences.en: The children saw Mark, so they gave him one of the pizzas.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们看见斑点， 所以他们给他一的这比萨饼。

sentences.en: "These pizzas are good," said Mark.
sentences.zh: 这些比萨饼是好的， 说斑点。 » 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: Biff looked at the chariot and she had a good idea.
sentences.zh: Biff 看在这双轮战车和她有一个好的主意。

sentences.en: The children had a banner.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们有一个横幅。

sentences.en: It was about the pizzas.
sentences.zh: 它是关于这比萨饼。

sentences.en: Mark put it on his chariot.
sentences.zh: 斑点放它在……上他的双轮战车。

sentences.en: The people laughed when they saw the banner.
sentences.zh: 这人们笑当……时他们看见这横幅。

sentences.en: "Why has Mark put a banner on his chariot?" People asked.
sentences.zh: 为什么有斑点放一个横幅在……上他的双轮战车？ 人们问。 人们付钱为了一个笑话！

sentences.en: "And what are pizzas?"
sentences.zh: 和什么是比萨饼？

sentences.en: The race began and everyone cheered when Mark came first.
sentences.zh: 这速度竞赛开始和每个人向当……时斑点来第一。

sentences.en: The people ran to buy the pizzas.
sentences.zh: 这人们跑到买这比萨饼。

sentences.en: "These pizzas are good," They said.
sentences.zh: 这些比萨饼是好的， 说斑点。 一个腿！ 他们说。

sentences.en: "What a good idea to put a banner on the chariot."
sentences.zh: 什么一个好的主意到放一个横幅在……上这双轮战车。

sentences.en: Just then, some soldiers grabbed the family and the children.
sentences.zh: 比萨饼 MIENU 火腿肉烂糊状物房间 Anchory Peperoni 油橄榄额外的 chede 素食者刚刚然后， 一些士兵抓住这家庭和这孩子们。

sentences.en: "You must stop selling pizzas," they said.
sentences.zh: 你必须停卖比萨饼， 他们说。

sentences.en: "The Emperor wants to see you.
sentences.zh: 这皇帝想要到看见你。

sentences.en: Come with us."
sentences.zh: 来和……一起我们。

sentences.en: The Emperor was angry.
sentences.zh: 这皇帝是生气的。

sentences.en: "This has got to stop," he said.
sentences.zh: 这个有得到到停， 他说。

sentences.en: "Who put this banner on the chariot?
sentences.zh: 谁放这个横幅在……上这双轮战车？

sentences.en: And what are pizzas?"
sentences.zh: 和什么是比萨饼？

sentences.en: "Would you like to try one?" Asked Diana.
sentences.zh: 会你喜欢到尝试一？ 问 Diana。 什么是比萨饼？ 问 Diana。

sentences.en: "They taste good," Said the emperor.
sentences.zh: 这比萨饼味道好的也。 他们味道好的， 说这皇帝。

sentences.en: "You can deliver some to the palace, but I don't want banners on the chariots, so take your banner away."
sentences.zh: 我不想要横幅在……上这双轮战车， 所以拿你的横幅离开。

sentences.en: Just then, the magic key glowed.
sentences.zh: 刚刚然后， 这魔法钥匙光亮。

sentences.en: Chip looked at the little banner.
sentences.zh: Chip 看在这小的横幅。

sentences.en: He put it on Biff's chariot.
sentences.zh: 他放它在……上 Biff 双轮战车。

sentences.en: "The Emperor didn't like banners on chariots," he said.
sentences.zh: 这皇帝没有喜欢横幅在……上双轮战车， 他说。

sentences.en: "I wonder what Mrs May will think."
sentences.zh: 我惊奇什么太太梅将想。
